source.name: Open English Wordnet 2025
source.changes: Selected source senses; independently reviewed Chinese teaching summaries added; not official Chinese dictionary text.

senses.definitionEn: a record or narrative description of past events
sourceExamples: a history of France
he gave an inaccurate account of the plot to kill the president
the story of exposure to lead

senses.definitionEn: a formal contractual relationship established to provide for regular banking or brokerage or business services
senses.glossZh: 账户；与银行等建立的业务关系
sourceExamples: he asked to see the executive who handled his account

senses.definitionEn: a qualitative change
the time period during which you are at work
a system of assumptions and standards that sanction behavior and give it meaning
senses.glossZh: 理解或判断事物的观念框架

senses.definitionEn: a framework that supports and protects a picture or a mirror
sourceExamples: the frame enhances but is not itself the subject of attention
the frame was much more valuable than the mirror it held

senses.definitionEn: additional proof that something that was believed (some fact or hypothesis or theory) is correct
senses.glossZh: 核实；为某个判断提供进一步证据
sourceExamples: fossils provided further confirmation of the evolutionary theory

senses.definitionEn: denoting an action or event preceding or in preparation for something more important
senses.glossZh: 初步的；在更重要的阶段之前或为其准备的
sourceExamples: a preliminary investigation

senses.definitionEn: formulation of the plans and important details
senses.glossZh: 计划及重要细节的拟定
sourceExamples: the framing of judicial decrees

senses.definitionEn: a framework that supports and protects a picture or a mirror
sourceExamples: the frame enhances but is not itself the subject of attention
the frame was much more valuable than the mirror it held

senses.definitionEn: occurring at the beginning
sourceExamples: took the initial step toward reconciliation

senses.definitionEn: be in charge of
sourceExamples: Who is heading this project?

senses.definitionEn: change place or direction
sourceExamples: Shift one's position

senses.definitionEn: move from one setting or context to another
senses.glossZh: 转移到另一场景或语境
sourceExamples: shift the emphasis
shift one's attention

senses.definitionEn: a person who owns something
sourceExamples: they are searching for the owner of the car
who is the owner of that friendly smile?

senses.definitionEn: the act of validating; finding or testing the truth of something
senses.glossZh: 确认有效性或真实性的检验

senses.definitionEn: make a record of; set down in permanent form
senses.glossZh: 记录；以可保存的形式记下

senses.definitionEn: formulate in a particular style or language
sourceExamples: I wouldn't put it that way
She cast her request in very polite language

senses.definitionEn: make up plans or basic details for
sourceExamples: frame a policy

senses.definitionEn: an advantage held by a competitor in a race
sourceExamples: he took the lead at the last turn

senses.definitionEn: a concise explanation of the meaning of a word or phrase or symbol
senses.glossZh: 定义；对词语或符号意义的简要说明

senses.definitionEn: clarity of outline
sourceExamples: exercise had given his muscles superior definition

senses.definitionEn: owed and payable immediately or on demand
sourceExamples: payment is due

senses.definitionEn: scheduled to arrive
sourceExamples: the train is due in 15 minutes

senses.definitionEn: capable of being assigned or credited to
sourceExamples: punctuation errors ascribable to careless proofreading
the cancellation of the concert was due to the rain
the oversight was not imputable to him

senses.definitionEn: allow or plan for a certain possibility; concede the truth or validity of something
senses.glossZh: 考虑到；把某种可能性或事实纳入考量
sourceExamples: I allow for this possibility
The seamstress planned for 5% shrinkage after the first wash

senses.definitionEn: adequate for practical use; especially sufficient in strength or numbers to accomplish something
senses.glossZh: 实用的；足以用于实际工作的
sourceExamples: the party has a working majority in the House
a working knowledge of Spanish

senses.definitionEn: adopted as a temporary basis for further work
senses.glossZh: 暂定用作进一步工作基础的
sourceExamples: a working draft
a working hypothesis

senses.definitionEn: (of e.g. a machine) performing or capable of performing
sourceExamples: in running (or working) order
a functional set of brakes

senses.definitionEn: serving to permit or facilitate further work or activity
senses.glossZh: 供进一步工作或活动使用的
sourceExamples: discussed the working draft of a peace treaty
they need working agreements with their neighbor states on interstate projects

senses.definitionEn: the first letter of a word (especially a person's name)
senses.glossZh: 首字母（尤指姓名的首字母）
sourceExamples: he refused to put the initials FRS after his name

senses.definitionEn: declared as fact; explicitly stated
in a commercial manner
sourceExamples: the product is commercially available

senses.definitionEn: under terms not final or fully worked out or agreed upon
senses.glossZh: 暂定的；尚未最终商定的
sourceExamples: probationary employees
a provisional government
just a tentative schedule

senses.definitionEn: a soft heavy toxic malleable metallic element; bluish white when freshly cut but tarnishes readily to dull grey
sourceExamples: the children were playing with lead soldiers

senses.definitionEn: a proposal intended to explain certain facts or observations
senses.glossZh: 假说；为解释事实或观察而提出的设想

senses.definitionEn: capable of reversing or being reversed
senses.glossZh: 可逆的；可以反向改变的
sourceExamples: reversible hypertension

senses.definitionEn: furnish a justifying analysis or explanation
sourceExamples: I can't account for the missing money

senses.definitionEn: something that results
sourceExamples: he listened for the results on the radio

senses.definitionEn: anything (such as a document or a phonograph record or a photograph) providing permanent evidence of or information about past events
senses.glossZh: 记录；留下以往事件信息的材料
sourceExamples: the film provided a valuable record of stage techniques
